title: Which national team will win the Boston quarterfinal at the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
background: Boston is scheduled to host a quarterfinal of the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official match result, corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve when the quarterfinal scheduled for Boston on July 9, 2026, concludes.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the winning national team's name. If the match requires a penalty shootout, the shootout winner counts as the winner.

title: Which country will win the 2026 FIFA World Cup quarterfinal scheduled for July 11 in Kansas City?
background: The winner of this knockout match will advance to the semifinals of the men's World Cup.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official match result for the quarterfinal scheduled for July 11, 2026, in Kansas City.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country whose national team wins the match and advances to the semifinals, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

title: Which national team will win the first semifinal of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, scheduled for July 14?
background: The winners of the World Cup's two semifinals advance to the championship match.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official match result, corroborated by reliable news coverage if necessary.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the national team that wins the first semifinal of the 2026 FIFA World Cup on July 14, 2026. If a penalty shootout is required, its winner counts as the match winner.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the winning national team.

title: Which national team will win the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup semifinal in Atlanta?
background: The winners of the World Cup semifinals advance to the final.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official match result or reliable contemporary reporting of the semifinal scheduled for July 15, 2026, in Atlanta.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the national team that wins this semifinal and advances to the final, including victory after extra time or a penalty shootout if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.

title: Which national team will win the third-place playoff at the 2026 FIFA Men's World Cup?
background: The third-place playoff is contested by the two teams eliminated in the semifinals.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official result for the 2026 Men's World Cup third-place playoff.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the winner of the third-place playoff, scheduled for July 18, 2026, including extra time or a penalty shootout if required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the winning country.

title: Who will win the Golden Boot at the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
background: The Golden Boot recognizes the World Cup's leading goal scorer, with FIFA's tie-breaking rules determining the winner if players finish level on goals.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 World Cup Golden Boot winner.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve upon confirmation of the award winner at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the player officially awarded the Golden Boot, rather than the Silver Boot or Bronze Boot.

title: Which country will win the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
background: The 2026 men's FIFA World Cup will be co-hosted by the United States, Canada and Mexico.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official final match result and announcement of the tournament champion.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the country whose national team wins the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup final, scheduled for July 19, 2026. A victory after extra time or a penalty shootout counts as winning the final.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.

title: Which player will win the Golden Ball at the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup?
background: The Golden Ball is awarded to the player judged the best performer at the FIFA World Cup.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official announcement of the 2026 men's World Cup tournament awards.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the player officially awarded the Golden Ball at the conclusion of the tournament, whose final is scheduled for July 19, 2026. This is the tournament-wide award, not an individual match award.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's name or established professional name.

title: Who will FIFA appoint to referee the 2026 men's World Cup final?
background: The final is scheduled for July 19, 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: FIFA's official appointment for the men's World Cup final on July 19, 2026, as announced before kickoff. Resolve to the main on-field referee named in that appointment.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-19
  • Accepted Answer Format: The referee's full name (string).

title: In which country outside Iran, if any, will US forces strike Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026?
background: Iran-aligned armed groups operate across several Middle Eastern countries, creating potential flashpoints for military confrontation with the United States.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera, supported where available by official military statements.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the country outside Iran where US forces conduct strikes against Iran-aligned armed groups between July 22 and July 29, 2026, inclusive. Direct US participation in either unilateral or joint strikes qualifies; threats, proposed operations, and diplomatic support do not.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name, or “None” if no qualifying strikes occur.

title: Which country will announce a new multinational maritime coalition to protect navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden by August 1, 2026?
background: Attacks on commercial shipping since 2023 have heightened concerns about the security of maritime trade routes through the Red Sea.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the country that announces the creation of a new multinational maritime coalition between July 1 and August 1, 2026, inclusive, with a stated purpose of protecting freedom of navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden. Joining an existing coalition does not qualify.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's common English name.
